description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, ads and boilerplate removed), with the title and metadata. Use it to read an article or docs page for summarising, quoting or RAG. Respects robots.txt.

include_images.description: Keep images in the Markdown (default false)

include_links.description: Keep hyperlinks in the Markdown (default false)

name: fetch_url_as_markdown
title: Web page to Markdown
